source: Minchat Shai on Gen 11:5 (Ramah; Masorah at Bo)
claim_en: וירד ה' לראת ("and the LORD came down TO SEE") — the Ramah: the see-infinitive is plene throughout the Torah EXCEPT THREE defective — the land that cannot BE SEEN under the locusts (Exod 10:5), God's descent TO SEE the tower (here), and "you cannot SEE My face" (Exod 33:20). SNAPSHOT: exactly those three defective, all others full — a trio about the limits of seeing, each missing a letter.

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Gen 11:3 (final-letter cipher)
claim_en: איש אל רעהו הבה ("each to his fellow: come!") — the FINAL letters spell שלוה ("tranquility"): "from excess tranquility they sinned" (Kitzur). SNAPSHOT finals locked in verse order.

בנסעם ("as they journeyed") — the Masorah pair, both in the Torah: the Babel migration (11:2) and the camp journeying from Sinai (Num 10:34): "that day they turned from following the LORD — like a child running from school; they journeyed מקדם — from the Ancient One of the world" (Kitzur). SNAPSHOT: exactly two tokens.

ויפץ ("and He SCATTERED") — the Kitzur's trio: Babel's builders (11:8), the people scattered through Egypt for straw (Exod 5:12), and the people scattering from Saul (I Sam 13:8) — "the tower-men and Egypt deserved one punishment." Torah-side: exactly the two; the Samuel leg is an inheritance edge.

ויחדלו ("and they CEASED") — the Masorah pair, both in the Torah: they ceased building the city (11:8) and "the sounds and hail CEASED" (Exod 9:33): "teaching that these too were judged with sounds and hail" (Kitzur). SNAPSHOT: exactly two tokens.

ודברים ("and words [few]") — the Kitzur's pair leaps to Ecclesiastes: "vanities and MANY WORDS" (Eccl 5:6) — "they multiplied speaking many vanities." Torah-side: the word's only token; the Ecclesiastes leg is an inheritance edge.

לאבן ("for stone" — brick served them for stone) — the Kitzur's pair leaps to Nabal: "his heart died within him and he became STONE" (I Sam 25:37) — "as there a death, so here: harder to them than death was a brick falling from the tower." Torah-side: the word's only token; the Samuel leg is an inheritance edge.

source: Minchat Shai on Gen 11:2 (Ben Asher; precise books)
claim_en: וימצאו ("and they found [a valley]") — the vav with the lengthening stroke (maarikh) "per Ben Asher, and so in the precise books": SNAPSHOT's codepoints carry the stroke — Ben Asher confirmation #3.
וראשו בשמים ("its head in the heavens") — the bet SOFT (no dagesh): bet+vowel contiguous in SNAPSHOT.
בני האדם ("the sons of man" — who built) — the bet with dagesh (doubling dot). SNAPSHOT agrees.
